body:
Rigorously speaking every test on connectInfinitHitsWithInsights should pass connectInfiniteHits test suite.
I was about to do that but it looked like a lot of tests to maintain and it's thoroughly covered by withInsights (which mocks a connector and specifically checks its props are preserved [here](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/insights-connector/src/lib/__tests__/insights-client-test.ts#L44-L67)).

Let's add that test since it's something exposed and if it's breaks for any reason it's best to know.
